note: 2026 prize winners used as a fixed test set. Names, prizes and institutions come from public announcements (Simons Foundation for the Fields Medals, NobelPrize.org coverage for the Nobel Prizes). ORCID iDs pinned here were supplied by Somesh; every other id is looked up by scripts/laureate_eval.py on each run (accepted only on a name and institution match). Pinned ids are checked against the OpenAlex author's name and reported as unresolved when they disagree. eval/cvs/<id>.pdf holds a saved public profile document for the resume path; profile_pdf_kind says what it is (a CV, a personal homepage or a Wikipedia article). Missing so far: profile PDFs for Pardon, Tsimerman and Halzen. Economics (announced Oct 12) is not in the list yet.
